name: Meghauli Serai, A Taj Safari
summary: A Taj-run safari lodge on the Rapti at Meghauli, facing the grasslands of Chitwan National Park. River-view rooms and villas, some with plunge pools, naturalist-led activities and Taj service make it the most polished place to stay in Chitwan.
body: Meghauli Serai is part of Taj Safaris, the safari arm of India's Taj group, and the brand's only lodge in Nepal. It sits on the north bank of the Rapti in Meghauli, west Chitwan, with the park across the water. Rooms and villas are built in a style drawn from Tharu architecture, with mud-toned walls and verandas, and look across the river to the Meghauli grassland. Some villas have private plunge pools; there is also a main pool, a dining area overlooking the river and a spa.

Stays are usually sold as full-board safari packages, including meals, jeep safaris, boat trips, guided walks and village visits with the lodge's naturalists. The park entrance is a short boat crossing from the lodge. It is about an hour by road from Bharatpur Airport. We use Meghauli Serai on our luxury safari and honeymoon itineraries, and it is popular with Indian families looking for familiar Taj standards in the jungle.
why: River-view rooms and villas facing the park, some with plunge pools
Taj-trained service and naturalists included in full-board packages
Quiet western sector of Chitwan with fewer vehicles

faqs.q: How much does Meghauli Serai cost per night?
faqs.a: Rates vary by season and room type and are usually sold as full-board safari packages including activities. Room-only rates have been seen from around US$ 320 a night before taxes, with packages considerably higher. Our 3-night luxury safari quotes an inclusive per-person price; ask us for current rates.

faqs.q: Is Meghauli Serai good for families with children?
faqs.a: Yes. It welcomes families, has a pool, spacious rooms and villas, and naturalists who adapt activities to children. Jeep and boat safaris suit all ages. Walking safaris have age limits. Book family rooms or connecting options early for October to December and Indian school holidays.

faqs.q: How do I reach Meghauli Serai from Kathmandu?
faqs.a: Fly Kathmandu–Bharatpur in about 25 minutes and transfer by road for about an hour; the lodge or we arrange the vehicle. By road from Kathmandu, allow 6–7 hours for about 190 km via Mugling and Narayangarh.

name: Barahi Jungle Lodge
summary: A riverside eco-lodge at Andrauli in Meghauli, with thatched cottages and rooms facing Chitwan National Park across the Rapti, a pool and a full programme of jeep, boat and walking safaris run by in-house naturalists.
body: Barahi Jungle Lodge stands on about 12 acres of riverbank at Andrauli, Meghauli, in west Chitwan, directly across the Rapti from the park. Accommodation is in thatched cottages and rooms with private verandas, spread through gardens so that most look toward the river. There is an outdoor pool, a restaurant serving Nepali, Indian and international food, a bar and a terrace where guests gather to watch the far bank for rhinos and deer at dusk.

Like Meghauli Serai, it sells full-board packages with activities: jeep safaris into the western grasslands, canoe and boat trips, guided walks, birding and Tharu village visits. It is about 35 km and an hour from Bharatpur Airport. We use Barahi on our birding tour, because its naturalists know the Meghauli grassland well, and as a slightly lower-priced alternative to the Taj for luxury and family safaris.
why: Thatched riverside cottages looking straight into the park
Strong naturalist team for birding and grassland safaris
Pool and gardens, at a lower price than the Taj

faqs.a: At Andrauli in Meghauli, west Chitwan, on the north bank of the Rapti facing Chitwan National Park. It is about 35 km and an hour by road from Bharatpur Airport, and around 190 km and 6–7 hours by road from Kathmandu.

faqs.q: Does Barahi Jungle Lodge offer elephant rides?
faqs.a: Some Chitwan lodges have offered elephant activities in the past. We do not book elephant rides or bathing at any property because of welfare concerns, and our packages at Barahi use jeep, boat, canoe and walking safaris, which show the park well.

faqs.q: Is Barahi Jungle Lodge good for birdwatching?
faqs.a: Yes. It sits beside the Meghauli grasslands and the Rapti, good for grassland and river birds, including the Bengal florican in spring. Ask for a birding naturalist when booking; we request one on our Chitwan birding tour.

name: Kasara Resort
summary: A modern villa resort in Patihani near the national park headquarters at Kasara, opened in 2022, with courtyard villas, family villas with private pools, a spa and safari activities organised by the resort.
body: Kasara Resort was built in 2022 on the edge of community forest in Patihani, Bharatpur, close to the Chitwan National Park headquarters and the gharial breeding centre at Kasara. Its design uses courtyards, earthy materials and gardens to sit low among the trees, and spotted deer and birds are often seen from the restaurant. Villas range from deluxe doubles to large family villas with private pools of around 130 m².

The resort has a full-service spa, an outdoor pool, gardens and a restaurant. It organises jeep safaris, canoe trips and guided walks into the park from the nearby Kasara and Patihani gates, which are quieter than Sauraha. Activities booked directly through the resort are priced at the top of the local range, so we include them in our package price. It suits couples and families who want privacy and a contemporary, design-led stay.
why: Private-pool family villas, rare in Chitwan
Close to park headquarters and the gharial breeding centre
Quiet Patihani location away from Sauraha's crowds

faqs.a: In Patihani, Bharatpur, near the Chitwan National Park headquarters at Kasara, on the north side of the Rapti. It is about 30 minutes by road from Bharatpur Airport and about 30–40 minutes from Sauraha.

faqs.q: Does Kasara Resort have private pool villas?
faqs.a: Yes. Its family villas have private pools, around 130 m² in size, which is unusual in Chitwan. Deluxe villas without private pools share the main outdoor pool. Private-pool villas sell out early in October, November and the Indian winter holidays.

faqs.q: Is Kasara Resort good for a Chitwan honeymoon?
faqs.a: Yes. Its villas, courtyards, spa and quiet setting suit couples, and the nearby Kasara gate gives access to less crowded parts of the park. It is an alternative to Meghauli for travellers who want a shorter airport transfer.

name: Green Park Chitwan
summary: A comfortable resort at Tiger Point in Sauraha, a short walk from the Rapti and the park gate, with air-conditioned rooms with balconies, an outdoor pool and children's pool, and full-board safari packages.
body: Green Park Chitwan is one of the better-equipped resorts in Sauraha, located at Tiger Point, around 3 km from the national park entry by the river and within walking distance of Sauraha's cafes and dance halls. It has around 32 air-conditioned rooms with balconies, minibars and satellite TV, an outdoor swimming pool, a children's pool, a restaurant and bar, and conference space that makes it popular with Nepali and Indian groups.

The resort sells packages that combine rooms and meals with jeep safaris, canoe rides, jungle walks, a Tharu village visit and the evening cultural show. Its convenient location and family facilities are why we use it on our 2-night jungle safari, 3-night safari and family safari packages. It is a step up from Sauraha's guesthouses without the price of the Meghauli lodges.
why: Pool and children's pool, good for families
Walking distance to Sauraha village and the Rapti
Reliable full-board safari packages at a mid-range price

faqs.q: Does Green Park Chitwan have a swimming pool?
faqs.a: Yes, an outdoor pool and a separate children's pool, which makes it a favourite with families. Pools are most welcome from March to June, when afternoon temperatures pass 30 °C. In December and January the water is cold.

faqs.q: How far is Green Park Chitwan from the national park?
faqs.a: It is in Sauraha at Tiger Point, about 3 km from the main park entry by the Rapti and a short walk from the village centre. Jeep and canoe safaris pick up from the resort or start a few minutes away.

faqs.q: Is Green Park Chitwan good for Indian families?
faqs.a: Yes. It is used to Indian families and groups, offers Indian vegetarian food, family rooms and a pool, and its packages bundle safaris and the cultural show. It is about 30 minutes from Bharatpur Airport.

name: Jungle Villa Resort
summary: A garden resort of about two dozen cottages on the Rapti at Patihani, close to the national park headquarters, with a pool, spa and naturalist-led safaris, and a quieter atmosphere than Sauraha.
body: Jungle Villa Resort sits on the northern edge of Chitwan National Park at Patihani, Bharatpur, on the bank of the Rapti and a short distance from the park headquarters at Kasara. It covers around two hectares of forest and mature gardens, with about two dozen air-conditioned cottages that have terraces facing the river or the garden. There is a restaurant serving Nepali, Indian, Chinese and Western food, using vegetables and dairy from local farms, plus a bar, pool and spa.

The resort's naturalists lead jeep safaris, jungle walks, birding, canoeing and village tours, starting from the nearby Kasara and Patihani entry points. The location gives easy access to the gharial breeding centre and the quieter central part of the park. We use it on our birding tour and as a calm alternative to Sauraha for couples and families. As with all our stays, we do not book the elephant activities some Chitwan lodges still sell.
why: Riverside cottages near the park headquarters at Kasara
Pool, spa and gardens in a quiet setting
Good base for the gharial breeding centre and central park

faqs.q: Where is Jungle Villa Resort in Chitwan?
faqs.a: At Patihani, Bharatpur, on the north bank of the Rapti close to the Chitwan National Park headquarters at Kasara. It is about 30 minutes by road from Bharatpur Airport and roughly 160 km from Kathmandu.

faqs.q: Is Jungle Villa Resort better than staying in Sauraha?
faqs.a: It is quieter, with a riverside garden setting and easy access to the central park near Kasara. Sauraha has more restaurants, shops and evening options. Choose Jungle Villa for calm and Sauraha for convenience and nightlife.

faqs.q: What activities does Jungle Villa Resort offer?
faqs.a: Jeep safaris, guided jungle walks, birdwatching, canoe trips on the Rapti and Tharu village tours, led by the resort's naturalists. Our packages include jeep, canoe and walk options but not elephant rides, which we do not book anywhere.

name: Tigerland Safari, A Lemon Tree Resort
summary: A riverside resort of 35 cottages at Jagatpur, Bharatpur, on the Rapti across from Chitwan National Park, operated under the Lemon Tree brand, with a multi-cuisine cafe and banquet space suited to families and groups.
body: Tigerland Safari stands in riverine forest on the bank of the Rapti at Jagatpur, Bharatpur, about 4 km from the national park and around 22 km from Bharatpur Airport. It is now managed under the Lemon Tree Hotels brand, which is familiar to Indian travellers. Accommodation is in 35 standalone wooden cottages with air conditioning, a seating area and private bathrooms, many with views toward the park across the river.

The resort has a multi-cuisine coffee shop, Citrus Cafe, a large banquet hall and meeting rooms, which makes it a popular choice for Indian family groups, weddings and corporate trips. Safari activities, canoeing and walks are arranged from the resort. Its location west of Patihani is quieter than Sauraha, and crocodiles, birds and occasionally rhinos are seen across the river. We use it for family and group safaris from India.
why: 35 standalone cottages in riverine forest on the Rapti
Lemon Tree management, familiar to Indian guests
Banquet and meeting space for family groups and events

faqs.q: Is Tigerland Safari a Lemon Tree hotel?
faqs.a: Yes. Tigerland Safari in Chitwan operates as Tigerland Safari, A Lemon Tree Resort, under the Indian Lemon Tree Hotels group. It was the group's second property in Nepal. Check the current brand arrangement when booking, as hotel management agreements can change.

faqs.q: How far is Tigerland Safari from Bharatpur Airport?
faqs.a: About 22 km, roughly 45 minutes by road. From Kathmandu by road, allow 5.5–6.5 hours. The resort is at Jagatpur on the Rapti, west of Patihani and the park headquarters.

faqs.q: Is Tigerland Safari good for group tours?
faqs.a: Yes. With 35 cottages, a banquet hall and meeting rooms, it handles family groups, school trips and corporate outings well. Book early for October to December and the Indian holiday season, when groups fill it quickly.
